# Intent: Establish greeting fixture returns Hello rehearsal

## In plain words

Confirm that the existing greeting fixture's greeting() function returns the exact string Hello rehearsal, establishing a known baseline for the lifecycle-pilot domain.

## Problem

The greeting() function in src/greeting.py must return exactly Hello rehearsal to satisfy the lifecycle-pilot domain's greeting contract. Without an explicit intent establishing this expectation, there is no traceable link between the fixture's required behavior and the verification and release process.

## Success measures

| Measure | Today | When reached | Observed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| greeting() returns exactly Hello rehearsal | not measured | greeting() == "Hello rehearsal" | source inspection of src/greeting.py |

## Not this

- Changing the return value of greeting().
- Adding new functions or modules beyond the existing fixture.
- Performance or load-testing of greeting().
